description: Vertical Home viewer with stable post deduplication and overlays hidden until tapped.

patches.name: Reddit - Hide app posts
patches.description: Hides interactive app and game posts in listings.

patches.name: Reddit - NSFW mode
patches.description: Shows only NSFW posts when on and only non-NSFW posts when off.

release_notes:
Fix repeating older posts during vertical Home pagination by comparing stable post IDs instead of the entire Link object. Also guard against duplicate rendered pages.

Titles, usernames, and controls now start hidden in the vertical viewer. Tap media to reveal them, and tap again to hide them. Ordinary media viewing retains its existing defaults.

Targets Reddit 2026.14.0. Build, local runtime regression checks, and combined patch application with upstream Hide ads/Hide navigation buttons passed. Device testing remains necessary for live scrolling and gestures.
